realizes.rationale: progressFigure consumes canonical entry progress through docProgress(entry), retaining the positive-total display guard instead of another row/document progress model.

Formats exactly the actual row hover: title, missing-authored-document notice, state/stage, repository, current step, progress with abandoned/discarded counts and host event when present. It does not render entry.scope, the full document reference path, a literal kind field, or retired lifecycle/worktree status.

1.note: The hover explicitly selects its actual rendered fields; scope and full reference path are not among them. This corrects an earlier Curator wording overstatement, not product behavior.
